rows.commentary: 0.1: Mayank Yadav unleashes extra bounce from a shortish length, and Shai Hope absorbs the lift to nudge a single backward of square.
0.2: Mayank Yadav keeps the pressure high with a tight middle-stump line, forcing Jewel Andrew onto the back foot to block towards mid-wicket.
0.3: Jewel Andrew does not score off Mayank Yadav.
0.4: Jewel Andrew takes 2 off Mayank Yadav.
0.5: Mayank Yadav drops it full and on off, drawing Jewel Andrew forward into a crisp drive that cannons straight into the hands of backward point.
0.6: Mayank Yadav steams in again, finding Jewel Andrew completely smothered by the mounting scoreboard pressure as another dot ball caps the over.
1.1: Arshdeep Singh fires one in from round the wicket, pinning Shai Hope back just enough to clip a brisk single toward mid-off.
1.2: Arshdeep Singh drops it full into the arc, and Jewel Andrew clears his front leg to launch it magnificently over midwicket for six.
1.3: Arshdeep Singh responds instantly with precision, hurling a surgical yorker past the flailing blade of Jewel Andrew.
1.4: Four to Jewel Andrew off Arshdeep Singh.
1.5: Arshdeep Singh crafts a clever slower off-cutter that Jewel Andrew slices aerially past the scrambling back-pedalling fielder to collect a pair of runs.
1.6: Arshdeep Singh misses his yorker with a low full-toss that Jewel Andrew clinically dispatches past the wide mid-off fielder to the boundary.
2.1: Wide from Mayank Yadav to Shai Hope, 5 runs in all.

2.1: Mayank Yadav hurls another ferocious short ball screaming down the leg side, sailing over Shai Hope's ducking helmet before Sanju Samson leaps sharply to his left, only for the umpire's arm to stretch horizontally signaling a no-ball that brings a wry smile from Morne Morkel and sets up a looming free-hit.
2.1: Six to Shai Hope off Mayank Yadav.

2.2: Mayank Yadav strays down the leg side with a length delivery, and Shai Hope misses his flick as the ball clips the pad and races away to the fine boundary for four leg byes, propelling the West Indies to a flying start.
2.3: No run for Shai Hope off Mayank Yadav.
2.4: Mayank Yadav drops it full and tails it back into middle, forcing Shai Hope forward to tickle an inside-half flick toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
2.5: Mayank Yadav angles a short-of-length delivery around off, allowing Jewel Andrew to drop back and pull it wide of deep mid-wicket for a comfortable brace as Ishan cleans it up.
2.6: Mayank Yadav bangs it short and down leg, evading Jewel Andrew's pull shot to earn an immediate wide signal from the umpire.
2.6: Mayank Yadav unleashes a wobble-seam rocket on a good length that nips back sharply over middle-stump, saving a lunging Jewel Andrew with extra bounce.
3.1: Prince Yadav drops it full just outside off, inviting Shai Hope into a pristine cover-drive that drills straight to the fielder stationed at extra-cover.
3.2: Prince Yadav serves one right in the slot on middle-stump, and Shai Hope answers with pure elegance, holding his shape to effortlessly loft it over the straight boundary.
3.3: Prince Yadav gifts a long half-volley outside off, which Shai Hope meets with an open face to surgically pierce the gap between backward point and point.
3.4: Prince Yadav attacks the stumps on a good length, prompting Shai Hope onto the back foot to tuck it cleanly out toward deep mid-wicket.
3.5: Prince Yadav digs it sharply into the pitch as Jewel Andrew retreats into the leg side, leaving the batter entirely unable to connect.
3.6: Prince Yadav follows Jewel Andrew outside leg with a low full-toss, catching an inside-edge off the pads that trickles toward mid-wicket for a single.
4.1: Axar Patel floats this arm ball right into the boots of Jewel Andrew, who dead-bats it straight back to the bowler.
4.2: Axar Patel locks onto the stumps with a skidding arm ball, trapping Jewel Andrew plumb in front to end a brisk twenty-one.
4.3: Axar Patel delivers, and Shimron Hetmyer shifts his weight backward to pull the angled length delivery out wide of long-on for a single.
4.4: Axar Patel arrows in a flat, good-length delivery outside off, and Shai Hope drops back to whip it straight to mid-on while abruptly halting Shimron Hetmyer's ambitious dash for a single.
4.5: Axar Patel flights this one up, and Shai Hope launches it monstrously over long-on to deposit the ball right into the top tier.
4.6: Axar Patel darts the arm ball on a fullish length outside off, and Shai Hope works it cleanly into the turf wide of mid-on to rotate the strike.
5.1: Arshdeep Singh bowls a wide to Shai Hope.
5.1: Arshdeep Singh drops in a low full-toss angling back, and Shai Hope strides forward to punch it straight to extra-cover with one hand flying off the willow.
5.2: A single to Shai Hope off Arshdeep Singh.

5.3: Arshdeep Singh bangs it in short and angling down leg, forcing Shimron Hetmyer onto the back foot where a hurried pull catches the glove and narrowly evades Sanju Samson's diving right glove to race away to the fence.
5.4: Arshdeep Singh fires in a low full-toss on middle, and Shimron Hetmyer lunges forward, heaving it off the bottom of the bat over mid-wicket to hustle back for a brace.
5.5: Wide from Arshdeep Singh to Shimron Hetmyer.

5.5: Arshdeep Singh launches a poor line delivery, Shimron Hetmyer drives it full and sliding down leg, flicking a thick inside‑edge onto the pad while fine‑leg is out of reach, leaving a deep backward square‑leg on his left unable to retrieve.
5.6: Shimron Hetmyer clears the boundary off Arshdeep Singh for six.
6.1: Axar Patel bowls a full‑on off‑beat; Shai Hope steps forward, drives the ball to sweeper cover for a tidy single.
6.2: Axar Patel delivers a flat, good-length ball on middle, allowing Shimron Hetmyer to drop back and calmly steer it toward the deep mid-wicket fielder for a single.
6.3: Axar Patel hurls a flat, back-of-a-length delivery on off, which Shai Hope punches sharply to the right of backward point, scampering through for a brisk single aided by Prince's chase.
6.4: Axar Patel drops it short on leg, Shimron Hetmyer crouches to sweep the length delivery into the gap, beating Prince at deep square-leg for four despite the fielder's chase.
6.5: Shimron Hetmyer does not score off Axar Patel.
6.6: Axar Patel delivers a blistering ball that Shimron Hetmyer smashes into a towering four, the bat echoing across the boundary.
7.1: Naman Dhir loops it up full on middle and leg, and Shai Hope launches it majestically over the rope for six.
7.2: A single to Shai Hope off Naman Dhir.
7.3: A single to Shimron Hetmyer off Naman Dhir.
7.4: Naman Dhir drifts it short down leg, allowing Shai Hope to drop back and pull it away to the deep backward square-leg boundary.
7.5: Shai Hope takes a single off Naman Dhir.
7.6: Naman Dhir drops it into the surface at a pedestrian pace, and Shimron Hetmyer fastens onto the back foot in a blur, launching the pull skyward and deep over the mid-wicket boundary.
8.1: Prince Yadav tests the off-stump with a tight, rising delivery, prompting Shai Hope onto the back foot to punch it crisply down to long-on for a single.
8.2: Prince Yadav extracts extra pace to hustle Shimron Hetmyer on the pull, offering a gentle return catch back to the bowler.

8.3: Prince Yadav drops a full one just outside off at 139kph, met by the forward press and solid defensive block of Rovman Powell towards cover, though Shai Hope instantly waves away the call for a single.
8.4: Prince Yadav targets the off stump with a sharp length delivery that nips back, allowing Rovman Powell to drop it softly in front of cover and scamper through for a single.
8.5: Prince Yadav bowls a wide to Shai Hope.
8.5: Shai Hope takes a single off Prince Yadav.
8.6: Prince Yadav targets the base of off-stump with a pinpoint yorker, leaving Rovman Powell to scramble it away through the turf for a single.
9.1: Axar Patel fires it flat and straight into the middle-stump line, forcing Rovman Powell onto the back foot to punch it safely back down the track.
9.2: Axar Patel floats this one fuller on off, and Rovman Powell steps forward to dead-bat it watchfully right back to the bowler for successive dots.
9.3: Axar Patel floats another full delivery up on off stump, easily smothered on the front foot by Rovman Powell.
9.4: Rovman Powell takes a single off Axar Patel.
9.5: Axar Patel fires it flat into leg, and Shai Hope drops back to nudge it toward deep backward square leg for a sharp couple.
9.6: A single to Shai Hope off Axar Patel.
10.1: Mayank Yadav steams in at 138.6kph, digging it short into the pitch where Hope mistimes his pull, dropping it safely in front of deep mid-wicket for a single.
10.2: Mayank Yadav drops it in short to Rovman Powell, who works it away into the outfield to hustle back for a sharp couple of runs.
10.3: Mayank Yadav unleashes raw heat from the surface, catching Rovman Powell high on the thigh pad as the hurried flick trickles away for a single.
10.4: Mayank Yadav delivers into the arc, and Shai Hope violently launches it over the ropes for six, bringing up his fifty off just 28 deliveries with a majestic blow down the ground.
10.5: Mayank Yadav steams in from back of a length at 138.3kph, and Shai Hope clips it firmly along the turf out toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
10.6: Mayank Yadav rattles through with serious pace from a hard length, catching Rovman Powell high on the hip as he swivels frantically across the line and misses.
11.1: Axar Patel darts it onto the pads, and Shai Hope instantly tucks it left of short fine leg to scamper through for a single.
11.2: Axar Patel delivers the in-drifter, and Rovman Powell drops to one knee to paddle it fine for four runs.
11.3: Axar Patel offers the slot ball, and Rovman Powell dances down the track to launch it cleanly over long-on for six.
11.4: Rovman Powell finds the boundary off Axar Patel for four.
11.5: Axar Patel delivers fuller into the surface, allowing Rovman Powell to pull it away toward deep midwicket and hustle through for a single.

11.6: Axar Patel offers a juicy, inviting slot delivery, and Shai Hope unleashes his classic, balanced stance to hammer it high and handsome over deep extra cover for a maximum that caps off a devastating twenty-two run over.
12.1: Rovman Powell takes a single off Arshdeep Singh.
12.2: Arshdeep Singh swings round the wicket to offer a wide, low full toss that Shai Hope drills firmly toward extra cover.
12.3: Arshdeep Singh misses his slower yorker entirely and offers a full toss on the stumps, allowing Shai Hope to stroke it straight down the ground for a single.
12.4: Arshdeep Singh drills a pinpoint yorker into the fifth stump, and Rovman Powell barely avoids his own timbers with a scrambling inside edge that races away for two.
12.5: Arshdeep Singh bowls a wide to Rovman Powell.
12.5: Arshdeep Singh smartly channels the wide angle, inducing the edge from Rovman Powell that Sanju Samson safely gathers behind the stumps.
12.6: Arshdeep Singh lands it on a length around off, tailing sharply inward to leave Sherfane Rutherford chasing thin air as the ball whistles past the outside edge.
13.1: Nitish Reddy serves a harmless length ball outside off, and Shai Hope rises to punch it straight to cover.
13.2: Nitish Reddy keeps it on a length outside off, prompting Shai Hope to shape up for an elegant drive straight to extra cover.
13.3: Nitish Reddy delivers a back-of-a-length ball at 128kph outside off stump, which Shai Hope violently drills straight to extra cover to scamper through for two runs.
13.4: Six to Shai Hope off Nitish Reddy.
13.5: Nitish Reddy serves it back of a length, allowing Shai Hope to loft a clean pull over deep midwicket and race back for a comfortable couple.
13.6: Nitish Reddy spears it into the stumps, and Shai Hope whips it away toward deep midwicket to collect a sharp couple.
14.1: Prince Yadav angles this length delivery across, prompting Sherfane Rutherford to punch it toward mid-off where a wayward shy at the non-striker's end gifts them an extra run on the overthrow.
14.2: Prince Yadav draws the edge from Sherfane Rutherford, but sharp reactions behind the stumps save certain boundaries as the ball bounces cleanly through to the keeper for a single.
14.3: A single to Shai Hope off Prince Yadav.
14.4: Prince Yadav strays down the leg-side with a short delivery, allowing Sherfane Rutherford to swivel smoothly and pull it away to the deep fine leg fence for four.
14.5: Prince Yadav slips in a 90.4kph slower yorker on the stumps, forcing Sherfane Rutherford to jam it straight back down the pitch.
14.6: Prince Yadav attacks with a full delivery outside off that cramps Sherfane Rutherford on the drive, conceding a single as it finds the fielder near mid-off.
15.1: Dot ball from Nitish Reddy to Sherfane Rutherford.
15.2: Nitish Reddy pitches it full and swings it back in from outside off, allowing Sherfane Rutherford to stride forward and punch it down to long-on for a single.
15.3: Nitish Reddy serves it full on middle, and Shai Hope lunges forward to loft a hurried on-drive that nearly picks out Tilak Varma at long-on.
15.4: Nitish Reddy serves up a wide, low full-toss that Sherfane Rutherford reaches for and slices past Arshdeep at short third man for four.
15.5: Nitish Reddy fires in a precise yorker outside off, allowing Sherfane Rutherford to open the face and squeeze a single past the left of Arshdeep at short third man.
15.6: Nitish Reddy nails the yorker on the leg-stump, tailing sharply back in, as Shai Hope clears his front leg to flick it away to deep square-leg for a single.
16.1: Mayank Yadav drops it short into the body, and Shai Hope clears his front leg to club it powerfully past the mid-on region for four.
16.2: Mayank Yadav offers a full delivery outside off, and Shai Hope loses his shape entirely while driving it on the bounce to Tilak at long-off for a single.
16.3: Mayank Yadav drops it short at thigh-height, but Sherfane Rutherford transfers his weight forward and absolutely murders the pull over deep mid-wicket into the top tier.
16.4: Sherfane Rutherford finds the boundary off Mayank Yadav for four.
16.5: Mayank Yadav drops it short into the ribs, but Sherfane Rutherford swivels effortlessly to shovel it over the deep midwicket rope for a maximum.
16.6: Sherfane Rutherford takes a single off Mayank Yadav.
Sherfane Rutherford hits boundaries off the last 3 balls faced as WI 206/3 (16.5).
17.1: Arshdeep Singh delivers a crisp ball to Sherfane Rutherford, who glides it past his open‑face bat for a dot.
17.2: Wide from Arshdeep Singh to Sherfane Rutherford.
17.2: Arshdeep Singh delivers a yorker to Sherfane Rutherford, who attempts a lofted shot that edges inside, landing in Sanju Samson's field.
17.3: Arshdeep Singh bowls a wide to Sherfane Rutherford.
17.3: Sherfane Rutherford clears the boundary off Arshdeep Singh for six.
17.4: Arshdeep Singh fires a wide, low full-toss that forces Sherfane Rutherford to stretch out, denying him any room to swing.
17.5: Arshdeep Singh drifts his low full-toss past the tramline, leaving Sherfane Rutherford unbothered as the wide is signaled.
17.5: Sherfane Rutherford lunges forward at a half-volley outside off, driving it past the diving extra-cover fielder for a brisk couple.
17.6: Arshdeep Singh tests the blockhole again, prompting Sherfane Rutherford to drill the ball on the bounce straight through to the wicketkeeper.
18.1: Shai Hope takes a single off Prince Yadav.
18.2: Prince Yadav pushes the ball full into the pads, and Sherfane Rutherford strides forward to sweep it away toward deep backward square-leg for a single.
18.3: Shai Hope finds the boundary off Prince Yadav for four.
18.4: Prince Yadav serves it full and wide, and Shai Hope drops low to sweep it out to the sweeper cover fielder for a single.
18.5: 2 runs to Sherfane Rutherford off Prince Yadav.
18.6: Prince Yadav digs this full delivery out, allowing Sherfane Rutherford to drill it straight down to long-on for a brisk single.
19.1: Nitish Kumar Reddy delivers a low full toss outside off stump, and Sherfane Rutherford shuffles across to swipe it off the thick inside half toward the vacant deep mid-wicket boundary for four.
19.2: A single to Sherfane Rutherford off Nitish Reddy.
19.3: Nitish Reddy serves it up full outside off stump, and Shai Hope drives it down to long-off for a single.
19.4: Nitish Reddy spears a full delivery angling away outside off, and Sherfane Rutherford opens the face to guide it toward backward point for a single.
19.5: Six to Shai Hope off Nitish Reddy.

19.6: Nitish Reddy serves up a full waist-high delivery, and Shai Hope shovels it across the line toward long-on, where Tilak Varma can only watch in despair as it bursts through his hands and sails over the ropes for a maximum that seals a magnificent century and caps West Indies' mammoth total at 247 for 3.
0.1: Roston Chase bowls a good length off‑swinger, Sanju Samson drives it cleanly over the ropes for a four, the crowd erupts in applause.
0.2: Roston Chase delivers a fullish off‑swinger; Sanju Samson steps forward and drives it to mid‑off, shouting a clear "no" as Abhishek Sharma watches.
0.3: Sanju Samson does not score off Roston Chase.
0.4: Roston Chase drops a length delivery outside off, and Sanju Samson works it smoothly toward backward square leg to rotate the strike.
0.5: Roston Chase drops it flat on a good length at leg-stump, and Abhishek Sharma guides it quietly into the open spaces of mid-wicket for a single.
0.6: Roston Chase fires in a surprise yorker at middle, which Sanju Samson digs out toward mid-wicket to steal a comfortable run.
1.1: Sanju Samson does not score off Shamar Joseph.
1.2: Shamar Joseph hurls it in, sliding agonizingly past Sanju Samson's leg-stump without a run to show for it.
1.3: Shamar Joseph oversteps for a no-ball, delivering a tight short ball that Sanju Samson slides through to short third man, setting up a free‑hit.
1.3: Four to Sanju Samson off Shamar Joseph.
1.4: Sanju Samson clears the boundary off Shamar Joseph for six.
1.5: Shamar Joseph delivers full, and Sanju Samson anticipates the trajectory instantly, launching the ball majestically over cow corner for a maximum.
1.6: Sanju Samson takes a single off Shamar Joseph.
Sanju Samson is putting on a show, dispatching the last two deliveries over the ropes with absolute disdain!
2.1: Roston Chase bowls a wide to Sanju Samson.
2.1: Sanju Samson finds the boundary off Roston Chase for four.
2.2: Roston Chase pushes it full into the middle stump, and Sanju Samson steps forward to effortlessly loft it over the head of the inner ring for a maximum.
2.3: Chase drops it on a length into middle and leg, allowing Samson to retreat and pull toward deep mid-wicket where Hetmyer fumbles just enough to gift the second run.
2.4: Chase attacks the pads with a searing yorker, expertly flicked wide of deep mid-wicket by Samson to jog through for a comfortable brace.
2.5: Six to Sanju Samson off Roston Chase.

2.6: Roston Chase switches over the wicket to deliver a good length ball on leg-stump, and Sanju Samson rocks back on his crease to hammer a ferocious pull past deep mid-wicket for four, roaring the stadium into a frenzy as fifty arrives in just three overs.
3.1: Romario Shepherd drops it short outside leg, Abhishek Sharma swings hard across the line but only finds thin air.
3.2: Romario Shepherd delivers back of a length on middle, and Abhishek Sharma taps it into the off side to scamper a sharp single.
3.3: Romario Shepherd delivers a length ball outside off, slammed hard by Sanju Samson straight to a sharp mid-off fielder who cuts it off cleanly.
3.4: Sanju Samson finds the boundary off Romario Shepherd for four.
3.5: Romario Shepherd strays in length, and Sanju Samson happily clips the full delivery away to the boundary.

3.6: Romario Shepherd drops it full and wide, drawing the reach from Sanju Samson who loses his bottom hand on the drive, dragging a thick inside edge away into the vacant expanse at mid-wicket for a single.
4.1: Keemo Paul draws the error first ball as Sanju Samson skies it straight into the waiting hands of Shimron Hetmyer to depart for a blistering 56.
4.2: Keemo Paul locks onto the middle stump, forcing Ishan Kishan forward to dead-bat a testing length ball sharply towards the cover fielder.

4.3: Keemo Paul unleashes a searing delivery that rears alarmingly over Ishan Kishan, leaving the batsman flailing wildly at thin air before Shai Hope gathers it overhead and the umpire extends his arms.

4.3: Keemo Paul rolls his fingers across the seam with a slower off-cutter, but Ishan Kishan reads the variation early, strides forward, and launches it straight down the ground for a maximum as Abhishek Sharma races in to celebrate.
4.4: Keemo Paul extracts his revenge immediately, tempting Ishan Kishan into another aerial stroke that instead finds the safe hands of Jewel Andrew to halt the batter's brief stay at the crease.
4.5: Keemo Paul drops it short outside off, allowing Shreyas Iyer to rock back and punch it into the vacant space with no backward point or deep point to cut it off.
4.6: A single to Abhishek Sharma off Keemo Paul.
5.1: Abhishek Sharma charges down to manufacture a shot, skewing a heavy inside edge off Shamar Springer down into the square leg pocket for one.
5.2: Shreyas Iyer takes a single off Shamar Springer.
5.3: Springer bangs it in short at one hundred and thirty-three kph, catching Abhishek in two minds as he attempts the pull and takes nothing off the bat.
5.4: Four to Abhishek Sharma off Shamar Springer.
5.5: Shamar Springer zeroes in on the pads, locking Abhishek Sharma into a defensive crouch as the ball skips away off the gear for a scampered leg-bye.
5.6: Four to Shreyas Iyer off Shamar Springer.
6.1: Roston Chase fails to score against Abhishek Sharma, who delivers a length ball that slips past the right‑hand bat.
6.2: No run for Abhishek Sharma off Roston Chase.
6.3: Abhishek Sharma takes a single off Roston Chase.
6.4: Roston Chase’s 1‑run off‑break finds Shreyas Iyer, who shimmies, flicks it to deep mid‑wicket.

6.5: Roston Chase delivers a back‑of‑length to Abhishek Sharma, who steps onto the back foot and pulls the ball deep to mid‑wicket for a single, the ball rebounding onto the pitch before striking the man.
6.6: Roston Chase bowls a length that spins in from outside off to Shreyas Iyer, who nudges it down towards long‑on for a single, the fielder sprinting in to contest.
7.1: Keemo Paul digs it in short outside off, forcing Shreyas Iyer to duck beneath the bounce before turning an inquisitive glance toward square-leg umpire Nitin Menon.
7.2: A single to Shreyas Iyer off Keemo Paul.
7.3: Keemo Paul strays down the leg-side, allowing Abhishek Sharma to shuffle across and glide the length delivery away for four.
7.4: Keemo Paul drops it full outside off, Abhishek Sharma leans into the loft off the toe, driving it straight on the bounce to Powell patrolling long-off.
7.5: Shreyas Iyer finds the boundary off Keemo Paul for four.
7.6: Keemo Paul slips his fingers across a full wide delivery, inviting Shreyas Iyer to reach forward and bunt it low to long-on for a single off the bottom half of the blade.
8.1: Shamar Springer delivers full outside off, and Shreyas Iyer punches it wide of long-on off the thick inner half for an easy couple.
8.2: Shamar Springer strikes as Shreyas Iyer edges it through to Jewel Andrew to depart for sixteen.
8.3: Tilak Varma takes 2 off Shamar Springer.
8.4: Springer rolls his fingers over this length delivery outside off, angling it away as Varma shifts his weight, fans the blade open, and guides it cleanly toward deep point for a single.
8.5: Shamar Springer rolls his fingers over a slower short delivery that climbs high past Abhishek Sharma's attempted pull, prompting the umpire to stretch his arms wide.
8.5: Six to Abhishek Sharma off Shamar Springer.
8.6: Shamar Springer bowls to Abhishek Sharma, who takes a single by driving a fuller ball well outside off to long‑off.
9.1: Chase spots Abhishek sliding down the leg side, fires a sharp shot across the stumps, and the ball is nudged to cover, leaving the wicket untouched.
9.2: Roston Chase bowls a slower, wide outside off delivery to Abhishek Sharma, who cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
9.3: Four to Tilak Varma off Roston Chase.
9.4: Roston Chase’s ball to Tilak Varma skims over the wicket, full and outside the leg‑stump, and Tilak Varma flicks but misses.
9.5: Roston Chase’s delivery to Tilak Varma turns into a 1‑run, with Tilak adjusting on the back foot and holding the shot well.
9.6: Roston Chase bowls a flat, good‑length delivery to Abhishek Sharma, who, knowing the next ball will be a drink, calmly steps back and nudges it to long‑on for a single.
10.1: Abhishek Sharma shuffles across the crease, but Romario Shepherd nails the line just outside leg to keep the umpire's arms firmly down.
10.2: Romario Shepherd digs it in short, and Abhishek Sharma top-edges a scrambling hook-pull down to fine leg for a single.
10.3: Romario Shepherd delivers a low-slanting ball past the furious heave of Tilak Varma, leaving batsman and bowler empty-handed.
10.4: Romario Shepherd drops it on a length sliding down leg, escaping Tilak Varma's desperate flick and the umpire's outstretched arms.
10.5: Tilak Varma finds the boundary off Romario Shepherd for four.
10.6: Tilak Varma clears the boundary off Romario Shepherd for six.
11.1: Abhishek Sharma finds the boundary off Gudakesh Motie for four.
11.2: Dot ball from Gudakesh Motie to Abhishek Sharma.
11.3: Gudakesh Motie outsmarts Abhishek Sharma, drawing the mistimed heave that sails straight into the safe hands of Shamar Springer to end a 29-run knock.
11.4: Gudakesh Motie outsmarts Naman Dhir with sharp turn, leaving Shai Hope ample time to whip off the bails and seal a golden duck.
11.5: A single to Nitish Reddy off Gudakesh Motie.
11.6: Motie floats it up near the channel at ninety-one clicks, and Varma whips it away to deep mid-wicket to keep the batting.
IND have swung this match right back their way, reaching 130 for 3 after 11.1 overs and needing 118 more!
12.1: Keemo Paul bowls a wide to Tilak Varma.
12.1: Six to Tilak Varma off Keemo Paul.
12.2: Keemo Paul bowls a wide to Tilak Varma.
12.2: Keemo Paul delivers a 117.3 kph ball to Tilak Varma, who flat‑bats it along the ground to mid‑on for a quick single.
12.3: A single to Nitish Reddy off Keemo Paul.
12.4: Keemo Paul drops the pace short into the surface, and Tilak Varma rocks back to force a firm pull straight to the fielder in the deep.
12.5: Keemo Paul rolls his fingers across another slower ball, catching the leading edge of Nitish Kumar Reddy's bat as it trickles out toward sweeper cover.
12.6: Wide from Keemo Paul to Tilak Varma.
12.6: Keemo Paul drops it on a length at 129kph, angling across as Tilak Varma drops to one knee for the slog sweep only to swipe through thin air.
13.1: Gudakesh Motie darts it straight into the leg stump, and Nitish Kumar Reddy whips it firmly away toward deep mid-wicket to rotate the strike with a single.
13.2: Byes off Gudakesh Motie's delivery to Tilak Varma, 4 runs in all.
13.3: Tilak Varma takes 2 off Gudakesh Motie.
13.4: Gudakesh Motie’s leg‑lined delivery finds Tilak Varma, who nudges it to deep square‑leg for a tidy two‑run brace.
13.5: Tilak Varma takes a single off Gudakesh Motie.
13.6: Gudakesh Motie unleashes a 97.5kph drive, barely missing the stumps as Nitish Kumar Reddy redirects it to long‑on, the ball skimming the carpet.
14.1: Nitish Reddy takes a single off Shamar Springer.
14.2: A single to Tilak Varma off Shamar Springer.
14.3: Nitish Reddy takes a single off Shamar Springer.
14.4: Shamar Springer digs it wide, and Tilak Varma shrewdly lets it pass through to the keeper without a flirt.
14.4: A single to Tilak Varma off Shamar Springer.

preview.text: India won the toss and chose to bowl first against West Indies in the T20 match at Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium. In their 31 recorded T20 meetings, India won 21 and West Indies won 10. The usual first-innings score in the 93 recorded T20 matches at this venue is 170.

summary.text: West Indies won by 24 runs. WI made 247-3, Shai Hope (c & wk) top-scoring with 102 off 50 balls; Prince Yadav took 1 for 36. IND made 223-10, Sanju Samson (wk) top-scoring with 56 off 23 balls; Keemo Paul took 5 for 41. Sides batting first at Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium usually make about 170.
